instruction: Add the prefix "2021_" to all sheet names (Sheet1 becomes "2021_Sheet1", etc.).

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a prefix to all existing sheet names. Evaluator checks that all sheets have the correct prefix applied.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Evaluator config missing getter function - only specifies metric 'check_xlsx_prefix_rename__51366842'
Data flow is broken: vm_file path is passed directly to metric instead of first going through getter
Metric expects 'result' to be a list of sheet names, but will receive a string file path from vm_file
Getter function 'get_xlsx_sheets__51366842' exists but is never called in evaluator.func
This will cause metric to return 0.0 at runtime due to type mismatch (isinstance(result, list) will be False)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add getter to evaluator config: change 'func' to use getter-metric chain
Option 1: Use evaluator.func as getter name 'get_xlsx_sheets__51366842' and evaluator.expected.type='vm_script' with metric in expected
Option 2: Create proper two-stage evaluation with getter extracting sheet names, then metric comparing them
The getter logic is correct (uses openpyxl to extract sheet names), but it needs to be connected to the evaluation flow
